item.title: Quest 1 - Eliminate the tax collector
item.description:
Got quest from NPC's > Kaiser:
Objectives:

kill Lord's Alliance's tax collector heading from Gulch to Mizzerville to tax Kaiser's Lord for Sunmaker
Kill Sheriff traveling from Gulch to Rawlington for 500gp
Log:

Intercepted both groups at Gulch
Found Session 3 - 03-26-2025 > Note to Sheriff Harthax

item.title: Session 1 - 03-12-25
item.description:
Traveled through portal to Redrun
Bought 3 axe beaks and one dire crab, Claudia
Saw Duergar woman Dornathir with 3 metallic goat: was told we couldn't afford it
Got quest from NPC's > Kaiser: kill Lord's Alliance's tax collector for Sunmaker, Kill Sheriff for 500gp

item.title: Session 2 - 03-20-25
item.description:
Discovered that cactus have arms and will defend themselves
Met tax collector: very rude
Traveled to Gulch: witnessed a duel, one person ran and the other whiffed
Sheriff walked out the wagon supply, distillery, and whorehouse
Talked to fence at Cartie's Original First Hand Store
was told ambushes happen at the fork
Lost some gold at the Temple of dice
Caraxis's caravan and - Dornathir pulls into Gulch, starts talking to sheriff
Dornathir turns away, Sheriff is drawing to shoot Dornathir
We start combat to attack sheriff to save Dornathir
Cut ropes of the sheriff's wagon
Pulls out mounted gun and fires on us and civilians

item.title: Session 3 - 03-26-2025
item.description:
We continue the fight

One deputy gets away
Kill knight, find wax sealed note inside (sealed with Mizzerlouix):

Sheriff Harthax and Sir Uttred The people in Mizzerville are in your debt. The men you bring to our cause from the Lord’s Alliance will be invaluable towards advancing the sovereignty of Redrun. Select only those most loyal to you. My man at the New Luskan branch of Mizzerlouix arms will provide you with one of our latest innovations to defend your caravan, should you be pursued by the Lord’s Alliance or beset on the road. With this parcel I have provided a nail imbued with magic of the new weave. Drive it into the wagon bound for Rawlington, and we will be sure to disrupt it only after it has left Rawlington. For this caravan you should select the men most loyal to the Lord’s Alliance. Accommodations and a titles await you.
Lord Maximum Mizzerlouix
Implications of the note: Kaiser is not working with Mizzerlouix
Loot:

5 talon gryphs
great sword
plate armor (16 AC b/c damaged)
25gp + long rest increases AC by 1, up to 18 max
2 talon raptors
deacon takes one
Priest has pockets full of clay casino chips with Count Rawling's Castle
1 labeled 1000
1 labeled 250
3 labeled 50
5 labeled 10
Fully stocked campsite
1 horse
Harry Wad took
9 GP each

item.title: Session 4 - 04-02-2025
item.description:
We traveled west, found a naked man at fork of road west of Gulch
After investigation, found that the man was a deputy who was shot point-blank in the front of the head with a large-caliber gun
While we're investigating, we see a halfling named Temmy Tinker with a wagon coming from the southwest peddling wares
Traded a spyglass for 2 Talon Gryphs and 5 gold
Traded 25 gold for information that he didn't see them coming from the southwest
Told us that there is a statue of Lathandar in Places > Midwest
Told us that there is an elf with blue eyes on the road, headed towards Places > New Pitthaven on a fast horse
Told us there are red storms to the west of Midwest
After a debate, we head north after Sheriff Harthax, hoping to beat him to Mizzerville before he gets there
After a day of travel, we see their camp fire roughly 12 mi ahead of us
After a second day of travel, we seem to have lost a mile
During the third night, we hear thunder strikes in the distance, but no rain
During the Fourth day, we find one of the wagons broken down and one of the crabs scorched
Dozens of spent shell casing surrounding the crab
Bodies littering both sides of the road peppered with bullets
gnomes, goliath, humans, elves, halflings - 9 total
they all have geometric tattoos - somewhat labyrinthian/fractal patterns
Detect magic revealed a nail driven in the wagon with divination magic - same nail referenced in Session 3 - 03-26-2025 > Note to Sheriff Harthax?
magic "feels" different than that of Faerun
Identify reveals that the nail is bound to a compass that always points to the nail
Just one burnt deputy
Seemed to have been a lightning strike
Fourth night: sheriff's fire is only 6 mi away, with 40 miles away from Mizzerville
Dust storm is picking up, howling in the distance
Deafened by bolt of red lightning striking near us

item.title: Session 5 - 04-09-2025
item.description:
got ambushed by red and black wolves
2 eagles, 4 black wolves
one red wolf poofed to dust when it died - seemed to have been a summon
eagle swooped by and seemingly called lightning
Harry hits the eagle, who transforms into a goliath woman out of wild shape and dies after falling
As we hit one of the black wolves, the dust storm falters - dropped concentration?
enemy casts wall of spikes - like spike growth (2d4 damage on movement), 2d6 on start of turn (dex save)
loud bang cancels wall of spikes
As I crest over the hill, we see the dwarf druid dead, blasted with a high caliber round
Can't see who shot
Lots of rolling hills ahead
all the druids have the red marks
Ended combat, but didn't take long rest

item.title: Pricing
item.description:
Caraxis's Caravans
Caravan travels 10-20 mi per day
New Luskan to Rawlington takes ~a month, with a 3 days rest in Midwest
Killing highway man is free premium tier:
Standard: 10g/week, no wagon
Premium: 20g/week, wagon seat and unlimited ale
ultra: 100g/week, all inclusive ale and food, personal mercenary

item.title: World
item.description:
Cacti can use arms to defend themselves

sweet, slightly viscous "blood" inside
Tax:

50% of all profit leaving redrun
Business:
Direcrabs: slower burst, more reliable long distance

Consume 1 unit of rations
Scavenging for Claudia: survival check, < 8 costs a ration, < 16 no cost, < 21 + 1 ,

Wyvern: Poker

ante 1 GP
roll 3d6
betting like poker
each round show dice of choice
After showing third dice, whoever has highest sum wins pot
Duster: Blackjack
Rules:
- Bet
- Roll 2d10, dealer rolls d20
- Can double after initial cast
- Can keep hitting d10 until player busts at 21+
- Dealer rolls until either
- He busts at 22+, stop hitting at 17
- Bust if sum over 21
Miner's dice: game of chance, play against house
choose 1-6
dealer choose 3d6
if 1 matches, get money back
if 2 match, get 2x money back
if 3 match, get 3x back
